messages.author: 3fd30254cc2deeb1
messages.subject: ability estimation
parts: I have estimated the ability for three parameter logistic model and nominal response model with the method of "ML",  however there are many cases with "-Inf, NA". What is the reason of this result? How could I handle this problem?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: ability estimation
parts:
You have response patterns with the absolute minimum value attainable in the test, therefore ML estimates cannot be computed because there is no unique maximum (see any text on IRT to discuss this issue, including the slides available on the wiki). 

Phil
